production.direction_en: Tilda and Iona have turned a storage room into a clinic. Kera sets the recovered ledger beside their medicine jars.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_warmth (muted: a clinic in a storage room) | post: bgm_quiet_sorrow on 'Fear takes longer.'

commands.speaker: tilda_fen
commands.text: We have one clean table and three patients. I can make it four if you stop bleeding on it.

commands.speaker: iona_mist
commands.text: She means welcome. Sit down before you fall down.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: I brought the ledger. Do not let anyone spill medicine on it.
